jobs.title: Managing Director, Head of Financial Engineering
jobs.description:
The Head of Financial Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the Financial Engineering function across Global Asset Management.

This leader will partner with investment, risk, client, operations and technology stakeholders to identify, prioritize, design and deliver advanced analytical tools, data solutions and decision-support capabilities that enhance investment outcomes, business effectiveness and client value.

The role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring that analytics and technology investments are aligned to business priorities and delivered through scalable, sustainable solutions.

The incumbent will lead a team of quantitative, analytics and engineering professionals while acting as a senior advisor to business leaders on data, analytics, investment technology and innovation opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

Three years from now this leader has:

Built a recognized Financial Engineering function.
Established a clear intake and prioritization model.
Delivered investment analytics and portfolio intelligence capabilities.
Improved the speed and quality of business decision making.
Created stronger alignment between Investment teams, Technology and Data organizations.
Established a team capable of delivering sophisticated analytics solutions at scale.

Core Accountabilities

Financial Engineering Strategy

Define the vision, operating model and roadmap for Financial Engineering across GAM.
Develop a multi-year strategy for analytics, investment tooling and decision-support capabilities.
Identify opportunities to leverage data, quantitative methods, automation and emerging technologies to solve investment and business challenges.
Evaluate external trends and industry practices to identify competitive advantages.

Business Partnership

Serve as a strategic advisor to senior business leaders.
Partner with Portfolio Managers, Research teams, Product leaders, Distribution leaders and operational partners to understand strategic priorities.
Translate business opportunities into technology, data and analytics solutions.
Establish governance frameworks for intake, prioritization and delivery.

Analytics and Solution Development

Lead the design and delivery of portfolio analytics, risk analytics, attribution, performance measurement and decision-support tools.
Oversee development of advanced analytical frameworks and data products.
Guide evaluation and implementation of quantitative methodologies and emerging technologies.
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable and aligned to enterprise architecture standards.

Portfolio Leadership

Lead a portfolio of strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.
Establish delivery roadmaps and execution plans.
Balance competing priorities across stakeholder groups.
Manage dependencies across business, data and technology teams.
Ensure realization of expected business outcomes.

People Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing Financial Engineering team.
Recruit, develop and retain quantitative, engineering and analytics talent.
Provide technical direction and coaching.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.
Establish standards, practices and methodologies for solution development.

Enterprise Influence

Develop trusted relationships with executives across GAM and enterprise partners.
Lead discussions involving complex technical and business concepts.
Influence investment and technology strategies through data-driven recommendations.
Represent GAM within enterprise analytics, technology and innovation forums.

Experience

Ideal Experience Profile

12-15+ years of progressive experience within Asset Management, Wealth Management, Capital Markets or Financial Services.
Experience leading analytics, quantitative, investment technology or financial engineering functions.
Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale data, analytics or technology capabilities.
Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams.
Experience leading large transformation programs and strategic initiatives.
Extensive stakeholder management experience with executive leadership teams.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of:

Portfolio construction
Investment analytics
Performance attribution
Risk analytics
Market and security data
Data architecture
Cloud-based analytics environments
AI and machine learning applications
Software development lifecycle and product delivery methodologies

Leadership Capabilities

Strategic thinking
Executive presence
Enterprise influence
Organizational leadership
Program governance
Change leadership
Decision making under ambiguity
Complex stakeholder management

Salary:

$120,000.00 - $215,000.00

Pay Type:

Salaried

The above represents BMO Financial Group’s pay range and type.

Salaries will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role, and may include a commission structure. Salaries for part-time roles will be pro-rated based on number of hours regularly worked. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.

BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards. BMO also offers health insurance, tuition reimbursement, accident and life insurance, and retirement savings plans. To view more details of our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.bmo.com/global/en/Total-Rewards

About Us

At BMO we are driven by a shared Purpose: Boldly Grow the Good in business and life. It calls on us to create lasting, positive change for our customers, our communities and our people. By working together, innovating and pushing boundaries, we transform lives and businesses, and power economic growth around the world.

As a member of the BMO team you are valued, respected and heard, and you have more ways to grow and make an impact. We strive to help you make an impact from day one – for yourself and our customers. We’ll support you with the tools and resources you need to reach new milestones, as you help our customers reach theirs. From in-depth training and coaching, to manager support and network-building opportunities, we’ll help you gain valuable experience, and broaden your skillset.

To find out more visit us at https://jobs.bmo.com/ca/en

BMO is committed to an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. By learning from each other’s differences, we gain strength through our people and our perspectives. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. To request accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Any unsolicited resumes sent to BMO, directly or indirectly, will be considered BMO property. BMO will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. jobs.title: Director, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Location:

243 Consumers Road, Toronto, Ontario, M2J 4W8

At Shoppers Drug Mart, we’re innovating health and wellness in Canada. From prescriptions to walk-in clinics, and a beloved loyalty program, we’re caring and supporting our customers in new ways every day.

With more than 1,300 locally owned and operated stores from coast to coast, the Shoppers Drug Mart network is more than a great place to shop, it’s a great place to work. We’re committed to building our talented team who champion collaboration, kindness and inclusivity. Join our team, and help recognize a healthy future for your career and for all Canadians.

Why this role is important?

Position Overview

Reporting to the SVP, Pharmacy, the Director, Strategy & Operations is a strategic partner to the Pharmacy Operations & Transformation leadership team, responsible for driving strategic planning, operational excellence, business transformation, and execution of enterprise and divisional priorities.

The Director translates complex business priorities into actionable plans, executive insights, and measurable outcomes. Key accountabilities include coordinating the Multi-Year Plan (MYP), Current Year Plan (CYP), leading cross-functional initiatives, and developing high-quality Board of Directors and executive leadership materials.

The role also champions artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and digital solutions to improve productivity, streamline processes, and enhance decision-making. Success requires strong strategic thinking, executive communication, analytical capabilities, and hands-on execution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Executive Partnership

Serve as a trusted advisor to the SVP and leadership team, providing strategic insights, business recommendations, and execution support.
Lead coordination of MYP, CYP, strategic reviews, and business planning processes.
Align cross-functional priorities, accountabilities, milestones, and measurable outcomes across Pharmacy and enterprise partners.
Anticipate business challenges, identify opportunities, and support executive decision-making.

Board & Executive Communications

Lead development of Board, Board Committee, Executive Leadership Team, and senior management presentations, briefing materials, and strategic reports.
Translate complex financial, operational, and strategic information into compelling, concise, data-driven narratives and actionable recommendations.
Manage executive reporting processes, coordinating stakeholder inputs, timelines, quality assurance, and final deliverables.
Anticipate leadership questions and ensure materials demonstrate accuracy, strategic alignment, and executive-level quality.

Strategic Initiatives & Transformation

Lead complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives and transformation programs from planning through implementation and value realization.
Establish project governance, workplans, milestones, accountabilities, risk mitigation, and performance reporting.
Facilitate executive steering committees, strategic workshops, and decision-making forums.
Drive change management, process redesign, implementation, and benefits realization across Pharmacy, Shoppers Drug Mart, and Loblaw Companies Limited.

AI, Technology & Automation

Champion responsible adoption of generative AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve productivity, efficiency, and business performance.
Identify and implement AI-enabled solutions for research, analysis, reporting, presentations, workflow management, and executive decision support.
Partner with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and business teams to prioritize and deliver automation and digital transformation opportunities.
Promote AI literacy, innovation, and continuous improvement while ensuring alignment with enterprise security, privacy, and governance standards.

Operational Excellence & Business Insights

Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and optimize business processes, operating models, and workflows.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives delivering measurable productivity gains, operational efficiencies, and cost savings.
Develop KPIs, dashboards, business cases, and performance reporting to support strategic decisions and track results.
Conduct business analysis, scenario planning, and opportunity assessments, translating insights into actionable recommendations.

Leadership, Collaboration & Governance

Build strong relationships across Pharmacy, Shoppers Drug Mart, Loblaw, and enterprise functions, driving alignment and accountability.
Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver shared objectives in a matrixed organization.
Coordinate executive meetings, strategic planning sessions, leadership communications, and governance forums.
Maintain confidentiality, sound judgment, and operational discipline while championing innovation and results-oriented execution.

Skills, Experience & Education

Strategic & Business Capabilities

Strong background in strategic planning, business transformation, operational excellence, and complex program execution.
Broad understanding of pharmacy operations, healthcare, retail, and enterprise business strategy.
Strong business acumen, financial literacy, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving.
Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives, manage competing priorities, and translate strategy into execution.

Executive Communication & Leadership

Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience developing Board and C-suite materials.
Advanced PowerPoint capabilities, executive storytelling, and ability to synthesize complex information into clear, decision-oriented recommendations.
Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, influencing skills, and cross-functional leadership.
Excellent judgment, attention to detail, adaptability, and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

AI, Technology & Digital Expertise

Advanced proficiency in generative AI and digital productivity tools, with demonstrated ability to improve analysis, reporting, workflows, and business outcomes.
Experience identifying and implementing automation, AI-enabled processes, and technology-driven operational improvements.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Automate, Power BI, or comparable platforms is highly desirable.
Understanding of responsible AI, information security, data privacy, and technology governance.

Role Requirements

5+ years of progressive experience in strategy, operations, transformation, consulting, or related leadership roles, preferably in pharmacy, healthcare, retail, or a complex corporate environment.
Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, healthcare administration, or a related discipline; MBA or graduate education preferred.
Proven experience supporting senior executives, developing Board-level materials, and executing enterprise strategic initiatives.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects, transformation programs, process improvements, and change management.
Practical experience applying AI, digital tools, and automation to improve business productivity and operational performance.
Strong ability to facilitate strategic discussions, influence without direct authority, and balance enterprise strategy with hands-on execution.
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or equivalent certification is an asset.
Knowledge of Loblaw and Shoppers Drug Mart systems, processes, and performance metrics is an asset.

Why work at Shoppers Drug Mart?

Acting as consultants, supporting internal customers and the Associate-Owners, you will get experience unique to the retail industry while working for an award-winning national brand. Benefit from a purchase discount program, competitive pay and online learning through Academy .

Take ownership of your work and find more ways to care about your work, co-workers, customers and community.

How You’ll Succeed

At Shoppers Drug Mart Inc., we seek great people to continually strengthen our culture. We believe great people model our values, are authentic, build trust and make connections.

If that sounds like you, and you are open-minded, responsive to change and up to the challenges provided in a fast-paced retail environment, apply today.

Employment Type

Full time

Type Of Role

Regular

Shoppers Drug Mart Inc. recognizes Canada's diversity as a source of national pride and strength. We have made it a priority to reflect our nation’s evolving diversity in the products we sell, the people we hire, and the culture we create in our organization. Accommodation is available upon request for applicants with disabilities in the recruitment and assessment process and when hired.

In addition, we believe that compliance with laws is about doing the right thing. Upholding the law is part of our Code of Conduct – it reinforces what our customers and stakeholders expect of us.

Please Note: If you have Employee Self Service (ESS) on Workday, apply to this job via the Workday application.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

We have an exciting opportunity for a Director of Finance to join a local, privately owned, growing company based in Edmonton, Alberta. Reporting to the President, the Director of Finance will be responsible for modernizing the accounting functions to drive the company’s metrics and performance to optimizing business processes. This role has a blend of strategic, out-of-the-box thinking while still being tactical to ensure bank reconciliation, monthly reporting and inventory controls are being performed in a timely manner.

THE ORGANIZATION

Founded in 1976, Nordic Holdings owns and operates a combined total of nine Konto Furniture and Sofa Land stores throughout Alberta with 120 team members on board. Both brands offer a unique blend of imported and domestic value-added home furnishings. If you’re looking to join a young, energetic, and successful team, this could be the opportunity for you.

For more information, please visit their website at www.nordicholdings.ca.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Director of Finance will have specific responsibilities for:

Strategy, Vision, and Leadership:
Advise company executives on financial planning, budgeting, cash flow, and investment priorities.
Serve as the management liaison to the shareholders or executives, effectively communicating critical financial matters.
Contribute to developing strategic goals and objectives, maintaining continuous communication between stakeholders.
Represent the organization externally, particularly in banking. Property accounting for related companies and accounting for 2 holding companies.
Other duties as assigned.

Team Development/Leadership:
Oversee, direct, and organize the work of finance and operations teams.
Promote a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and commitment to quality.
Partner with Executives to establish and monitor shared services performance metrics.
Ensure staff members receive timely and appropriate training and development.

Operations:
Upgrade and implement an appropriate system of policies, internal controls, and procedures.
Develop tools and systems to provide critical financial and operational information to stakeholders.
Plan, coordinate, and execute the annual budget process.
Oversee the approval and processing of revenue, expenditure, and position control documents.
Ensure compliance with local, provincial, federal, and reporting requirements.

Tactical Duties:
Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.
Provide internal customer support to all departments and retail locations.
Complete bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations.
Build out budgets and implement variance reporting for actuals to budget.
Compile and submit monthly GST returns.
Track and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPI’s) monthly.
Continuous improvement of accounting policies, procedures, and controls.

QUALIFICATIONS

7+ years of experience in accounting operations.
CPA Designation with a Bachelor Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
Extensive experience and knowledge in dealing with accounting systems, budgets, and internal controls.
Knowledge and experience with full-cycle bookkeeping.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Proven track record of facilitating progressive organizational change and development.
Strong mentoring, coaching experience in a team with diverse levels of expertise.
Entrepreneurial team player with the ability to work independently in a dynamic setting.
Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Actively seeks out and drives opportunities for improving processes and automation.
Enthusiastic and team-focused attitude with excellent problem-solving skills.

FOR MORE INFORMATION, PLEASE CONTACT

SANDY JACOBSON
| T: 780.944.1327| E: sandy.jacobson@richardsonsearch.ca | www.richardsonsearch.ca

jobs.title: Associate Director, Media Strategy
jobs.description:
Role - Associate Director, Media Strategy

Location: Montreal, QC | Hybrid (3 days/week in office)

Salary
: $90,000 - $100,000

What You'll Do
Drive Integrated Media Strategy

Develop customized 360° media strategies
aligned with client business objectives, marketing strategies, consumer needs, and growth opportunities.
Lead integrated media planning and execution across digital and traditional channels
.
Build innovative, data-driven media ecosystems focused on performance, optimization, and measurable results.
Develop consumer journeys, messaging frameworks, media KPIs, and measurement strategies.
Stay ahead of emerging media, technology, audience, and consumer trends to identify new opportunities.
Translate complex media and data insights into clear, actionable business recommendations.

Be a Strategic Client Advisor

Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and become a strategic partner to clients.
Advise senior leadership on media strategy, performance, market opportunities, and evolving industry trends.
Develop a strong understanding of clients' industries, competitive landscapes, business challenges, and opportunities.
Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance and expand strategic partnerships.
Proactively address campaign challenges and develop solutions that protect both performance and client relationships.
Lead and facilitate strategic workshops focused on consumer journeys, messaging, media performance, and business objectives.

Lead & Develop Teams

Provide strategic direction and guidance to media strategists and other specialists.
Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of integrated campaigns.
Mentor and coach team members while supporting their professional development.
Share media expertise through internal training and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Help establish and evolve media best practices, processes, tools, and methodologies.
Foster a collaborative environment where teams can do their best work.

Drive Operational Excellence

Help ensure effective execution of agency processes, including SOWs, BCRs, hours, invoicing, and campaign workflows
.
Partner with senior leadership to improve processes and ways of working.
Take a proactive, solution-oriented approach to resolving complex project and campaign challenges.

What You'll Bring
5–7+ years of experience
in media strategy, media planning, or a related discipline, primarily within an agency environment.
Strong experience developing and executing integrated/360° media strategies
.
Deep understanding of the modern digital media ecosystem, including programmatic, SEM, paid media, audience strategy, data, measurement, and optimization
.
Solid knowledge of traditional media
, with the ability to connect offline and digital channels into cohesive media strategies.
Experience advising senior stakeholders and major clients
.
Strong presentation, communication, and business skills.
Ability to translate data and media insights into strategic business recommendations.
Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating media strategy teams
.
Strong organizational and project-management skills.
A collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset.
Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

The Leadership Mindset
We're looking for someone who brings both strategic expertise and strong people leadership
.
Empathetic leader:
You support, coach, and develop people while bringing teams together around a shared vision.
Strategic thinker:
You see the bigger picture and can connect media decisions to broader business and marketing objectives.
Transparent communicator:
You build relationships through honesty, accountability, and trust.
Agile problem-solver:
You thrive in complex environments and are comfortable adapting when priorities change.
Collaborative partner:
You believe the strongest work comes from bringing different perspectives and areas of expertise together.

What You'll Get
Hybrid work:
3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely.
Generous time off:
3 weeks of vacation plus an agency-wide holiday closure.
Additional personal time:
Doubled public holidays, 5 personal wellness days, and 1 volunteer day.
Comprehensive benefits:
Life, prescription drug, dental, paramedical, travel, and other coverage options.
Wellness support:
Annual reimbursement toward fitness activities or home fitness equipment.
Transportation benefits:
Discounts on public transit and bike-sharing memberships.
Professional growth:
Work alongside experienced media professionals and have a direct opportunity to influence strategy, processes, and the future direction of the agency.
